incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: HIGH GPU util on dedicated-pool-eu-west-1 (rule: dedicated-gpu-util > 85% for 2m). alert_id=PD-78123 link=https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-78123
PD (PagerDuty): Incident PD-78123 created and notification sent to on-call
Aaron: ack'd. grabbing graphs now. any customer impact flagged?
Marta: seeing a short spike on the serving-proxy replicas, 1-2 mins ago. spikes align with a small batch of long-context requests. not seeing 5xxs yet.
Samir: checking routing. looks like one route started sending heavy bursts to pool "dedicated-eu-west-ml". could be canary traffic?
Aaron: rolling quick query: `curl -s https://console.metrics/api/q?m=gpu_util&pool=dedicated-eu-west-ml` returns 92% at peak then drop to 64% in last sample.
Marta: no customer-facing errors in SLO dashboard, request latency slightly higher for those few minutes but < SLO.
Samir: running `kubectl get pods -n serving -l pool=dedicated-eu-west-ml -o wide` to check node pressure.
Aaron: saw autoscaler briefly spin up 1 extra node around the spike, then it settled. looks like autoscale handled it.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-78123 auto-resolve attempt: alert resolved by policy (transient spike).
Marta: hmm PD auto-resolved. still want to monitor for recurrence. I'll mute noise on this rule to 4m evaluation window to reduce flapping.
Samir: agreed we should adjust the evaluation window and add a short burst exemption for canary routes. I'll open a PR to docs/alerting with rationale.
Aaron: leaving a note for next oncall: `dedicated-eu-west-ml saw a short GPU util spike ~92% caused by bursty canary traffic; autoscaler added capacity; no 5xxs or customer impact observed; PD auto-resolved`. pinging Ops Shift Lead for visibility. :eyes:
Ops Shift Lead: thanks — please add runbook step to check `serving-proxy` backpressure metrics next time. also add a quick link to the autoscaler logs.
Marta: adding links: metrics snapshot https://metrics.example/snapshot/3532108888, autoscaler logs gist https://gist.example/auto-logs-3532108888
Samir: PR opened for alert tuning: https://git.example/repo/alerts/pull/214 — propose eval=4m and exempt canary route.
Aaron: handing off to night oncall (Samir) — if it recurs please escalate to oncall-sre and follow the runbook. I'm available if it re-escalates. :+1:
Samir: taking handoff. I'll keep an eye on dedicated-eu-west-ml for the next 2h. marking this thread resolved but pinned notes in pagerduty.
incident-bot: Thread closed (no further activity).
